summary: FHLBNY filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 furnishing its monthly President's Report to shareholders for September 2026, issued October 8, 2026, as Exhibit 99.1. The report reviews the Bank's liquidity mission, member advances, and community support, noting $70.9 million in 2026 Affordable Housing Program grants and nearly $140 million made available in 2026 across AHP and additional housing and community development activities. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is ordinary issuer communication, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
